text:
maria (People Ops): hey @kevin, congrats on the conversion! quick Day-1 checklist since you're moving from contractor -> full-time next Wednesday:
- I-9: we need Section 1 completed and Section 2 verification within 3 business days. you can do remote upload or book kiosk.
- background check: vendor requested previous legal names/aliases. please confirm.
- benefits: enrollment window opens on day 1; if docs pending you can elect a waiver and enroll retroactively within 30 days.
- payroll: name on payroll must exactly match SSN card or passport. any mismatch can delay first paycheck.

kevin (New Hire): thanks @maria! quick issue: my passport has my full middle name "Alexander" but the offer and my contractor W-9 used "Kevin A. Liu". will that block I-9?

elan (People Ops): short answer: possibly. payroll & I-9 require an exact match to legal name on the primary ID (usually passport or SSN). we can accept a scanned passport plus a signed "name declaration" form to reconcile minor differences (e.g., middle name spelled out vs initial). i'll attach the declaration form to your onboarding portal.

kevin (New Hire): ok can do that. vericheck portal is asking me to list "other names used" for the last 10 years. i used a different last name for a short period (was on a school record). do i list it?

vericheck-bot: VeriCheck update  action required: please provide all legal names, aliases, and former names used in the past 10 years. missing names may trigger manual review which delays clearance. If you have court docs or marriage records, upload as supporting docs.

kevin (New Hire): will upload that. question: can we do remote Section 2 verification? i'm still finishing contractor offboarding remote and won't be in SF until Day 4.

maria (People Ops): remote Section 2 is allowed only for certain exceptions. because you're converting and have payroll implications, we prefer in-person verification within 3 days. if you're out of town longer, we can use a verified third-party agent near you. share your city and we'll check partner availability.

kevin (New Hire): i'm in Austin TX.

elan (People Ops): we have a partner network in Austin. option A: book our local partner for Section 2 within 3 days. option B: fly into SF and use our kiosk. which do you prefer?

kevin (New Hire): partner in Austin works. please send details. also my laptop shipment shows "delayed - address mismatch"  worried it won't arrive by Day 1.

it-shipping-bot: Shipping alert for package PKG-22110: status "address verification required". Recipient: Kevin Liu. Please confirm current address on file: 4107 Maple Ave, Apt 2, Austin, TX 78756. Reply with CONFIRM or UPDATE with new address.

kevin (New Hire): CONFIRM.

it-shipping-bot: Thanks. Courier updated address and rescheduled delivery. ETA: next business day morning. If delivery misses Day 1, IT can hold a loaner at the Austin partner pickup location. Reply LOANER to reserve.

kevin (New Hire): LOANER please, thanks.

elan (People Ops): noted. @payroll we'll queue provisional payroll with pending name reconciliation. payroll, flag: new hire Kevin Liu (contractor conversion) - possible name variance between offer and passport.

payroll (Payroll): acknowledged. We'll provision with a pending payroll hold. Payment will be released after ID reconciliation and SSN verification. Please upload the signed name declaration and a clear scan of the passport.

kevin (New Hire): uploaded passport scan & signed declaration to the portal. also uploaded a PDF showing the school record with prior surname as requested by VeriCheck.

vericheck-bot: VeriCheck received documents. Status: documents uploaded. Next: manual review by vendor (24-48 hours). If additional records are required you will be notified.

susan (Onboarding Buddy): welcome officially! i'll run a 15-min sync Day 1 at 09:30 CT to go over benefits and intro. i'll send a calendar invite. if the laptop is delayed, we'll use a loaner and get your core accounts provisioned ASAP.

maria (People Ops): great follow-through everyone. summary: Austin partner booked for Section 2 (we emailed the appointment info), loaner reserved if needed, name declaration & passport uploaded, VeriCheck processing. Kevin, please ping here if you get any vendor emails that look odd before signing. see you Day 1 389
